name: game-about-digging-a-hole-together-december-4
note: A Game About Digging A Hole Together revealed at the ID@Xbox x IGN Showcase (Xbox Wire recap 20 Oct 17:45Z): Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC and Game Pass on 4 Dec 2026; Mi'pu'mi Games, published by rokaplay Select and Shochiku (Steam 4018610). Template trailer. Footage: the official reveal trailer (Steam), 1080p, shots with the friends in frame; its own music from 21 s (no voices). v2: cover on the beach friend, shots where the friends are centred (the launch out of the hole, the shop window), the treasure line on the chest cave; v1 opened on a first-person drill and put the date on a dark cave wall.
